# Corrupted parquet fixtures

These files are generated by `build_fixtures.py` and used by
`tests/test_corrupt_parquet.py`. They are committed so the regression runs
offline without regenerating anything.

| File | Shape |
| --- | --- |
| `source.parquet` | 8 rows, 2 columns (`id` int64, `payload` string), 2 row groups of 4, uncompressed, PLAIN, no dictionary pages. Values: `p00-alpha` … `p07-alpha`. |
| `neighbor.parquet` | Same schema/layout with distinct values `n00-omega` … `n07-omega`; used as a healthy file in the same CLI expression. |
| `data_page_corrupt.parquet` | Source footer preserved byte-for-byte. Only the first value-length word of row group 1 / `payload` is changed (9 → 5), so page decoding fails. |
| `wrong_offset_same_page_boundary.parquet` | Every data byte preserved. Only the footer's row group 1 / `payload` `data_page_offset` is changed to point at the row group 0 / `id` page header. |
| `wrong_offset_mid_header.parquet` | Footer-only wrong offset that lands inside a page header, as a control for a failure that escapes the ArrowInvalid catch layer. |

Regenerate with:

```bash
python tests/fixtures/corrupt/build_fixtures.py
```

`build_fixtures.py` asserts the damage from source bytes and footer fields
(footer equality, single changed word, metadata equality after substituting
the declared offset). It does not decide success by observing a reader error.
